fields.description:
## Proposed solution

Review the CMS integration scoping document and identify any Salesforce-side configuration that can be completed while sandbox access is still pending.

Post the list of buildable items, and any open questions, as a comment on this card ahead of tomorrow's call.

## Acceptance criteria

* List of SF-side items buildable without sandbox access is posted on this card.
* Open questions are posted before the call.

Kobi, 2026-09-10.
fields.summary: BUILD-280 — CMS Integration: Salesforce-side configuration review

comments.body:
Hi [@Kobi Kunasekaran](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/profile/1203115293332591), see below the things we can build ahead of the CMS sandbox. 

* **Auth & connection design**: External Credential (Custom auth, one principal, header `X-Webhook-Key`) → Named Credential at `https://wagertech-cms-tkqruf7sva-uk.a.run.app`, callout path `callout:<NamedCredential>/api/salesforce/deals`. Only the click-through setup and dropping the real secret into the principal wait on access.
* **Field mapping**: All core payload fields already exist — `External_Deal_ID__c`, `Operator_External_ID__c`, `Partner_External_ID__c`, `Vertical__c`, `Source__c`, `Deal_Status__c`, `CurrencyIsoCode`, `Effective_Start_Date__c`. No new fields needed for the payload itself.
* **Region derivation**: `region` isn't a stored field — needs logic derived from `Market_Country__c` + `Market_State__c`. Can be spec'd now.
* **New fields to design**: `Sync_Status__c` (picklist), a sync-error detail field, `Last_Synced_Date__c`, optionally a self-lookup `Superseded_By__c` for Retire & Replace.
* **Flow design**: record-triggered Flow on Deal__c (trigger conditions, HTTP Callout, fault path), a validation rule locking the five makeup fields once Active, and a uniqueness check across the makeup combination - if not yet existing.
* **Error handling & retry design**: retryable-vs-terminal split is already given (503/timeouts retry; 400/401/409/422 need a fix first). Can spec a `CMS_Sync_Log__c` audit object and an Apex Queueable for bulk resync (≤200/call).
* **Permissions**: field-level security plan for the new sync fields. 

Most of the big questions are already covered, but I have a quick question about retries:

* **Retry strategy — automated vs. manual?** The doc splits failures into two classes: 503/timeout/network (explicitly safe and welcome to retry) vs. 400/401/409/422 (explicitly "do not loop... need a fix first"). Given that split, do we: 

* Build automated background retry (capped attempts + backoff) for transient failures only, and leave business-rule failures (400/409/422) as surface-and-fix-manually?
* Or keep everything manual for V1 — surface all failures the same way and require a person to trigger every resend, transient or not?
* Separately: for `unknown_operator`/`unknown_partner` rejections, the fix happens on WagerTech's side (they map the account in the CMS), not in Salesforce — so nothing on the Deal record changes to naturally re-trigger a resend. Do we need a manual "Resend to CMS" action just for that case?
* And do we want an admin-triggered bulk resync (the Apex Queueable already specced for up to 200/call) as a safety net for "CMS was down and a batch of deals are stuck," independent of whichever retry approach we pick?
